g.text: Example scheduling snapshot; threads may migrate.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

g.text: Two cores can execute separate software threads while sharing lower-level memory

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Illustrative dual-core topology with private L1 and shared L2; actual cache organizations vary. Thread mapping is a scheduling example, not permanent
affinity. Coherence and synchronization are needed for correct shared-memory behavior; simultaneous execution does not automatically double performance.
